poem.author: 李白
englishLines: Li Bai boards his boat, about to leave,
When suddenly a farewell song rises from the shore.
The Peach Blossom Pool may be a thousand feet deep,
Yet not as deep as Wang Lun's friendship for me.

appreciation.zh: 临行时忽然响起的踏歌，让深深的桃花潭也比不过朋友真挚的情意。
appreciation.en: A surprise farewell song makes even the deep Peach Blossom Pool seem shallower than a friend's sincere affection.

pages.zhText:
李白乘舟将欲行，
忽闻岸上踏歌声。
桃花潭水深千尺，
不及汪伦送我情。
pages.enText:
Li Bai boards his boat, about to leave,
When suddenly a farewell song rises from the shore.
The Peach Blossom Pool may be a thousand feet deep,
Yet not as deep as Wang Lun's friendship for me.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Bright spring morning at Peach Blossom Pool, Li Bai in a white-blue Tang robe stands safely in a small roofed wooden passenger boat near shore while his friend Wang Lun in a warm ochre robe arrives beneath blooming peach trees with several villagers singing and stepping rhythmically, turquoise water and layered hills, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
李白乘舟将欲行，
行李已经放好，小船正要离开岸边。
pages.enText:
Li Bai boards his boat, about to leave.
His bundle is packed, and the boat is ready to push off.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium-wide view of the same Li Bai standing steadily inside the same moored wooden boat beside a seated boatman, a simple travel bundle secured under the canopy as the boat begins to turn from shore, peach blossoms overhead, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
忽闻岸上踏歌声。
岸上忽然传来脚步和歌声，是朋友赶来送行。
pages.enText:
When suddenly a farewell song rises from the shore.
Footsteps and singing announce a friend who has come to say goodbye.
pages.illustrationPrompt: The same Li Bai turns in delighted surprise toward shore as Wang Lun and friendly villagers perform a gentle Tang-era stepping song under peach trees, hands raised in greeting, boat still close and safe, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
桃花潭水深千尺，
碧绿的潭水映着山影，看起来又清又深。
pages.enText:
The Peach Blossom Pool may be a thousand feet deep.
Clear green water holds the reflections of tall mountains.
pages.illustrationPrompt: High wide view emphasizing the clear deep-looking turquoise pool with mountain and peach-blossom reflections, the same boat and farewell group small but clearly visible near the bank, peaceful water with no danger, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
不及汪伦送我情。
再深的潭水，也比不上朋友送别的情意。
pages.enText:
Yet not as deep as Wang Lun's friendship for me.
Even this deep pool cannot match a friend's heartfelt farewell.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Warm medium scene across a short stretch of water: Li Bai bows with both hands from the boat while Wang Lun returns the farewell bow from shore, their smiling eyes meeting, peach petals drifting between them, no text in image.

pages.zhText: 小船慢慢向前，岸上的歌声却一直跟着。诗人看见潭水，也听见友情。
pages.enText: The boat glides on, but the song follows. The poet sees the water and hears friendship in every note.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Long panoramic square composition of the same boat moving gently across the pool while Wang Lun and villagers continue waving and singing on the peach-lined shore, soft sound-like ripples spreading across the water without graphic symbols, no text in image.

pages.zhText: 真正的朋友，会让一次告别也带着温暖。离得再远，那份情意还在心里。
pages.enText: A true friend can fill a goodbye with warmth. Distance does not erase what the heart remembers.
pages.illustrationPrompt: The same Li Bai sits under the boat canopy farther from shore, one hand over his heart and a warm smile as he looks back toward tiny Wang Lun beneath the blossoms, calm hopeful mood, no text in image.

pages.zhText:
李白乘舟将欲行，
忽闻岸上踏歌声。
桃花潭水深千尺，
不及汪伦送我情。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
Li Bai boards his boat, about to leave,
When suddenly a farewell song rises from the shore.
The Peach Blossom Pool may be a thousand feet deep,
Yet not as deep as Wang Lun's friendship for me.
Now read it softly once more.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing wide view at golden spring light, the same boat follows a shining path across Peach Blossom Pool while Li Bai and Wang Lun still wave to one another, blooming shore and blue-green mountains holding the scene together, no text in image.
